question_en: Which companies contributed most to resolutions under NR MIMO (Agenda 7.1)? Top 10.

semantic_units.original_quote: Which companies contributed most to resolutions
semantic_units.judgment: Company identities occupying a top10 contribution selection. The English does not separately request numerical contributionCount; count is the selection statistic. No causal/patent ownership claim is required.
query_clauses: RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT a) AS contributionCount

semantic_units.judgment: The phrase gives both a technology description and a numbered agenda. Source agenda identity is meeting+number, not a universal topic. Literal 7.1 spans inspected LTE E-UTRA maintenance in #84 and broad NR maintenance in #115; explicit NR MIMO headings in #115 are8.1/8.16.1. Taking all numeric7.1 agreements as NR MIMO would discard a question constraint; taking all MIMO headings would discard the authored numeric scope. A user/author scope decision is required before adopting either as the answer population.

Original design positively defines references as Tdoc numbers in Resolution content, and submission via Phase1 Source. Documentary contribution counts over REFERENCES→SUBMITTED_BY are authorized; actual physical causation/adoption by each company is not an invented prerequisite. Source-own reference fidelity would still be checked for an admitted query.

Authored exact metric is distinct Agreement nodes per submitted Company. Multiple referenced Tdocs/paths must not multiply the same Agreement for one Company. No distinct Tdoc or path-count replacement is allowed.

Top10 is explicit and original CQ3 default agrees. Broad all-topic or all-record technical completeness is not a new prerequisite, but the ten identities must be computed in the intended population. The fresh diagnostic populations actually yield different ten-company sets.

Descending count is explicit. Original query has no secondary key; generic Company ASC must not silently replace this exact instance. Numeric, component∩MIMO and lexicalMIMO diagnostic cutoff ranks have distinct10th/11th counts, so their differing sets are not caused by an internal tie.

semantic_units.unit: unverified additional inputs or external interpretation
semantic_units.judgment: A complete NR MIMO technology taxonomy, meeting restriction, cross-meeting agenda renumbering, or identifier-over-topic priority is not given. Source captions are real evidence but lexical MIMO includes LTE; none of the diagnostic topic predicates is declared the new gold. Exact authored query is strong counterauthority for literal numeric interpretation and is preserved, but it does not on its own resolve the source-demonstrated mismatch in the English constraint.

strongest_counterinterpretations.support: The canonical instance explicitly asks numeric STARTS WITH7.1 over Agreement nodes, and original-query authority is stronger than a generic default. A truthful answer can label the numeric results with an explicit correction of the NR MIMO description.
strongest_counterinterpretations.why_not_automatic_pass: Such a correction is not present in the immutable evaluated English; accepting numeric-only scope while scoring it as NR MIMO would treat incompatible LTE/broadmaintenance populations as the requested topic. Author confirmation that the topic is merely an erroneous descriptor would resolve this branch.

strongest_counterinterpretations.support: Both the technology and number appear in the question, so keeping only NR-MIMO-relevant records within literal7.1 is plausible.
strongest_counterinterpretations.why_not_automatic_pass: A source-supported NR-MIMO relevance rule for generic NR-maintenance Agreements is not supplied by this instance. Literal MIMO-caption intersection also includes LTE, and cannot be adopted as an exact NR-topic classifier.

strongest_counterinterpretations.support: The question says NR MIMO, and actual #115 own headings place that topic at8.1/8.16.1.
strongest_counterinterpretations.why_not_automatic_pass: Dropping the explicit7.1 parenthetical or declaring a complete lexical taxonomy is a scope choice. Current modified Korean dataset does this but is not original author authority.

important_nonclaims: No semantic impossibility or permanent unanswerability claim.
No absence of a complete NR MIMO source population was inferred from caption matches.
No original 10-company membership is claimed source-certified by two report headings.
No wrong7.10 prefix inclusion occurred in this actual frozen dataset.
needed_author_clarification: Specify whether Agenda7.1 is the intended numeric cross-meeting scope (with NR MIMO corrected as a descriptive error), or NR MIMO is the intended technology scope across renumbered agendas, or a defined NR-MIMO subset of numeric7.1 is intended.

after_clarification.numeric: Preserve exact DISTINCT Agreement/10 query semantics; verify own references/submitted Company and native/SQL/scorer before admission.
after_clarification.topic_or_intersection: Declare source-supported topic/meeting/renumbering rule, then query repair and full finite entrant/attribution verification; no selected diagnostic becomes gold by itself.
